points.quote: **`Event` subscriptions** return an `IDisposable`. Calling `dispose()` removes the listener.
Subclasses call `this._register(x)` on anything they own. When the owner is disposed, everything registered is disposed too.
**`DisposableStore`** is a bag of disposables. ... `toDisposable(fn)` wraps a cleanup function.
**`MutableDisposable`** holds a single value. Assigning a new one disposes the old.
`ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite()` ... installs a `DisposableTracker` before each suite and checks after each test that nothing is left undisposed.
